title: Just wanted to see what I could build with Codex... ended up making a game
author: MoeSissler
selftext:
So I've been messing around with Codex lately, just to see how far I could get with building a game using AI.

Didn't really expect to end up with something I'd actually publish, but here we are. 😅

The game is called JADD (Just Another (Damn) Defense). It's a small sci-fi defense game for Android.

Codex basically did all the coding, while I came up with the ideas, tested things and tried to figure out what I actually wanted.

And here's another thing I thought was pretty cool: I used Claude to handle the whole Google Play registration and setup through Chrome. So even all that annoying account and publishing stuff was done with AI.

Not saying everything went perfectly, but it's honestly pretty wild how far you can get with these tools.

Anyway, JADD is now live on Google Play, which still feels a bit strange to say. 😂

Has anyone here done something similar with Codex or Claude? Would be interesting to hear how you guys use AI for game development.

And if anyone feels like giving JADD a try, I'd love to hear what you think. Criticism is welcome too!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.moes.jadd
